title: Trace recursive returns
description: Implement trace_sum(values) using a recursive helper with index i. Emit ["enter", i] before each call checks its base case, including i == len(values). Emit ["return", i, total] just before each call returns its suffix sum. Return the complete event list; do not change values. Each recursive call waits for exactly one smaller subproblem.
hints: Separate validation, state changes and output.
Try an empty case, an exact boundary and repeated operations.
